{{Quote|I've heard rumors, of a smuggler in the mountains, north of here. Maybe he could provide some assistance.|Rohan Wayside to Lt. Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="BFN" />}}
'''Rohan Wayside''' was the leader of a [[Trading village (Naboo swamps)|trading village]] in the swamps of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]]<ref name="BFN" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">The events of ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' occur during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Shortly after the conflict began, the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|forces]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] launched an [[Skirmishes in the Naboo countryside|attack]] on the village Wayside and their people were inhabiting and demanded the village's surrender. The [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] fled deeper into the swamps in their [[Naboo houseboat|houseboats]], but came under fire from [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboats]] when they refused to surrender. Wayside and their people were rescued by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Naboo Resistance]]. In gratitude, Wayside sent their best [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Vedd Deviss]], to [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|lead]] the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] resistance to an influential [[Borvo|smuggler]]. The information provided helped the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] eventually end the invasion.<ref name="BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rohan Wayside's first appeared in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. In the mission in which they appears, the player, controlling Sykes, is tasked with saving a number of houseboats. The game does not specify which houseboat Wayside inhabits. They were voiced by [[Doug Boyd]].<ref name="BFN" />
